# EmptyState

A friendly placeholder for when there's nothing to show yet, with the next step as a button.

`CLR.EmptyState` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.EmptyState title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.EmptyState" title="…"></x-import>
```
